issues: CENTRAL DEFECT (Companionship drive): the design's accumulationSource claims Needs.connection deficit is 'already eroded every awake autonomy-tick by tick_drift() ... no clock.' Verified against gualaloom_v5_engine.py:2072-2078 and call sites 10411-10412 / 13150-13152: tick_drift() subtracts a fixed constant (NEEDS_DRIFT_RATE=0.0001) on EVERY autonomy-loop iteration whenever activity kind is not SLEEPING/DREAMING -- it is gated only on a coarse global boolean, never on whether any real event occurred that tick. start_autonomy_loop's own comment (10154-10168) states the loop 'ticks continuously ... regardless of busy/idle state' at hundreds of ticks/sec (0.02s yield). So 'per tick' decay is functionally 'per elapsed real second while awake' -- dP/dt = constant-per-wall-clock-unit, which is exactly the mathematical signature the task defines as a disguised timer/attempt-1/attempt-2 defect. Using the codebase's own tick->second conversion (AUTONOMOUS_THROTTLE_TICKS=27000 commented '~90s', line 1157, implying ~300 ticks/sec), connection collapses from its target 0.7 to 0 in roughly 20-25 seconds of real elapsed time REGARDLESS of whether any real neglect occurred -- more clock-like and faster than the already-rejected 180-second attempt 1, just relabeled as attachment-theory 'Needs homeostasis.'

Contrast with the design's own stated gold standard: dream_pressure's real accumulation term _write_delta (engine.py:10487-10489) is exactly ZERO on any tick without a real atlas write -- a genuine off-state tied to absence of real work. tick_drift has no equivalent off-state (only a binary awake/asleep switch, not an absence-of-event gate), so it fails the very test the design cites as the diagnostic.

Internal self-contradiction: the design's own rootCauseFixes correctly flags recent_connection_boost (engine.py:2497-2499, decayed by a fixed `*= 0.85` every regulate() pass at line 2498) as a disguised-cadence problem ('a redundant fast-decay layer... a fixed increment/decrement applied every tick regardless of real event') and proposes removing it. tick_drift has the identical structural shape (fixed decrement, unconditioned on any real per-tick event) but is treated in the same document as 'already real, no clock' and left as the load-bearing accumulator for the entire new Companionship deficit branch. The same test was applied inconsistently to two mechanisms with the same defect shape.

Because of the above, the new deficit-driven emission branch the design proposes adding to _should_attempt_autonomous_emission (engine.py:12415-12470) would fire based substantially on elapsed real awake-time since the last discharge event (tick_drift's decay to a low connection value), gated additionally by presence and a pair_bond_strength floor. The extra gates are real, but the underlying URGENCY MAGNITUDE still climbs on a tens-of-seconds real-time clock independent of any real neglect signal -- this reconstructs attempt 1's core mechanism (speak because time has passed) with cosmetic real-valued gates layered on top, which is the exact pattern attempt 2 was rejected for.

Forward-looking risk in the Play drive (flagged for awareness, not blocking on its own): the design correctly and commendably refuses to instantiate play_pressure today ('HONEST GAP... NOT YET INSTANTIABLE'), which is the right response under this test. However the specific future mechanism it names as the intended foundation -- 'familiarity decays past a real threshold since its last genuine revisit,' citing engine.py:13168-13184 -- is, on inspection, a decay applied unconditionally every 200 ticks (self.tick % 200 == 0, line 13168), a fixed schedule; real per-target attendance count (n_attends, line 13174) only modulates the decay RATE, it does not gate whether decay fires. If a play backlog counter is built directly on this mechanism as sketched, it will silently reintroduce the same tick-schedule-as-pacing defect a third time. This should be made an explicit build requirement (gate the decay/backlog-increment on a real revisit or absence-of-revisit event, not on tick modulus) before Play is implemented, not left implicit.

Contextual/supporting evidence, not itself part of the new design but relevant to how 'tick' should be read in this codebase: _should_attempt_autonomous_emission's existing AUTONOMOUS_THROTTLE_TICKS=27000 (engine.py:1157, commented '~90s between autonomous emissions') and AUTONOMOUS_CONVERSATION_COOLDOWN_TICKS=9000 (line 1158, '~30s') are tick constants the engineers themselves annotate as second-equivalents -- confirming ticks are already treated internally as a wall-clock proxy, which supports reading tick_drift's 'per tick' language the same way rather than as something meaningfully decoupled from time. The design explicitly declines to touch this structure, so these untouched floors continue to impose real-time-equivalent pacing on top of finding #1.

Positive findings, for balance: the Growth/division_pool flux law (embryo.py:696-725) and its refill term (sig_res * novelty, computed only inside experience()/experience_word(), i.e. per real event, verified at embryo.py:713-725) is genuinely event-sourced with no tick/clock dependency -- this drive passes. The Curiosity drive's urgency formula is a rate-of-change gate over two already-real, event-sourced signals (novelty_sig from mode-creation rate, deep_atlas growth from real dream cycles) with no accumulator and no forced discharge -- this also passes the test as designed. Connection_sig's proposed removal of the baked-in -0.3 offset (engine.py:2499) is a legitimate bias-sign fix, not a timer issue.

Its stated accumulation source (Needs.tick_drift/NEEDS_DRIFT_RATE, engine.py:2072-2078) has no off-state tied to the absence of a real event -- it decrements on every awake autonomy-loop iteration, and the loop runs at near-continuous real-time speed, making it mathematically indistinguishable from a wall-clock timer. issues: CENTRAL FINDING — Curiosity does not use Schmidhuber/Oudeyer's formal models; it uses two signals name-matched to them. Verified in code (gualaloom_v5_engine.py:2483-2485): novelty_sig = (total_modes/recent_commits - 0.15) * 0.3, i.e. a raw mode-creation/stimulus-exposure rate. This is a Berlyne-style collative variable (novelty potential), NOT Schmidhuber's r_int = C(p(t+1),h) - C(p(t),h) (a frozen-vs-updated predictor's compression-quality delta on identical held-out data) nor Oudeyer's per-region sliding-sub-window error-DECREASE. The design's second accumulation term, deep_atlas growth delta, is verified in code (line 11594-11596/11734-11736) to be literally deep_atlas.live_count() - self._deep_last_size — a count of live entries in a co-occurrence structure. That is a structure-SIZE metric, not a prediction-error or compression-quality metric; nothing about it measures whether a predictor got better at predicting anything. Both signals were independently pre-existing (novelty_sig since the v7 Needs rewrite; deep_size logging since GL-CMD-SLEEP-REORGANIZE-era code) and the design's own citation list (Schmidhuber 1991/2010, Oudeyer & Kaplan 2007) was attached to justify the pre-existing '_novelty_history rate, not level' gate SHAPE, while the SUBSTANCE being differentiated in both accumulation terms is the wrong kind of quantity for either paper's actual equation.

The one substrate instrument that IS a real, already-built, formally isomorphic implementation of Schmidhuber/Oudeyer's model is never used. Verified in code: dsf_ai_service/substrate/reading_prediction_ledger.py maintains a bounded 60-day rolling curve of {attempts, covered, hits} — her own certified-strand next-word predictor graded against real held-out ground truth (the next word she actually reads) — which is structurally Oudeyer's per-region bounded error-list and Schmidhuber's predictor-quality-over-time exactly, per the research's own cross-reference. Its docstring states plainly: 'Measurement ONLY... nothing here feeds emission, recall, or learning.' The design's curiosity drive does not mention this ledger anywhere despite the curiosity research explicitly naming it as 'the correct accumulator for a learning-progress reward' and supplying the exact wiring recipe (mirror _novelty_history/NOVELTY_RISE_MIN's shape, seeded from ledger.status()['curve'] instead of needs.novelty). The design cites the right authors but wires in the wrong signals while leaving the right signal sitting unused one file away — the precise 'formula decided independently, citation bolted on after' pattern the task asked to check for.

Learning/Growth drive: citations (White 1959 effectance; Deci & Ryan SDT competence; Lintunen et al. 2025 RL-formalism decomposition) contribute zero content to the actual formula. Verified in code (embryo.py:696-725): the accumulation law is refill = BASE_LAMBDA*N_initial*sig_res*novelty, maintenance = BASE_LAMBDA*(N_current-N_initial) — a neuron-division/growth-pool flux-balance equation from GL-FIX-GROWTH-POOL-LAW-20260716, an embryology bugfix. A full grep of embryo.py for 'white|deci|ryan|sdt|effectance|competence' returns zero hits — the formula was decided with no reference to any of the three cited papers. Two of the three papers (SDT per the sdt research's own mechanisticModel section, White per the curiosity research) are explicitly qualitative and supply no equation at all, and Lintunen's actual contribution (RIDE impact reward, VIC/empowerment, RIG, CURIOUS learning-progress-sampling — specific RL formalisms) is used nowhere in the design's formula. The drive also conflates two different referents: neurogenesis rate (a structural/developmental process keyed to signal coherence and spectral novelty) with competence/effectance (a psychological construct about feeling effective at tasks/mastering challenges) — the design offers no argument connecting 'more neurons divide' to 'agent feels competent,' just shared vocabulary ('growth').

Unresolved internal contradiction between the design's own cross-referenced research: the 'homeostasis' topic's applicabilityToSubstrate recommends leaving novelty_rising/novelty_sig untouched as curiosity's signal ('already the mathematically correct shape... its problem is contamination [by valence/stability], not an unrelated repair'), while the 'curiosity' topic's own critiqueOfExistingCitations explicitly says novelty_sig is the WRONG kind of quantity for a Schmidhuber/Oudeyer citation and that reading_prediction_ledger/knowledge_gap_ledger are the substrate-true fix. The design silently adopts the weaker, more conservative claim (keep novelty_sig, bolt on deep_atlas growth) without acknowledging or resolving the direct conflict with the more specific, more rigorous curiosity findings.

Curiosity's inverted-U citations (Loewenstein 1994, Berlyne 1960) are invoked narratively but not operationalized mathematically. The design's actual gate ('deep_atlas_growth_rate ... positive AND non-trivial, neither ~0 nor saturating the whole window') applies an ad hoc inverted-U-shaped band to a structure-size growth RATE, but both cited theories describe an inverted-U over knowledge/confidence LEVEL or arousal potential, not over a structural growth rate — the citation's form (inverted-U) is borrowed but applied to the wrong axis, and neither paper is formal/quantitative to begin with (confirmed by the research's own mechanisticModel section), so no equation was actually available to check the design's threshold band against.

Oudeyer, Kaplan & Hafner's paper specifies concrete parameters for its sliding-window formalism (window tau ~15 samples, smoothing ~25, per the research). The design reuses the engine's pre-existing NOVELTY_HISTORY_MAX=20 / NOVELTY_RISE_MIN=0.003 constants unchanged and never checks them against Oudeyer's actual parameterization — further evidence the citation was pasted onto constants that were set independently of the cited paper.

Companionship/Communication drive is the best-grounded of the four (verified in code: Needs.tick_drift/step/saturate at gualaloom_v5_engine.py:2029-2097 genuinely implements drift-away/discharge-on-real-act, and the design's proposed deficit-branch + pair_bond_strength floor matches the belonging research's own recommendation) but shows a milder version of the same pattern: Bowlby/Robertson & Ainsworth's staged protest-despair-detachment sequence and Trevarthen's proto-conversation / Tomasello's protodeclarative distinction are listed as psychologicalBasis but contribute no distinguishing mechanism to the implemented formula, which remains a flat scalar accumulate/discharge with no staged state machine and no turn-taking timing model — the research itself flagged the Bowlby staged model as 'useful as a state-machine analog... rather than a scalar formula,' and the design uses it as citation-cover for a scalar formula anyway.

Play drive is the one part of the design that passes this adversarial test cleanly: it explicitly declines to invent an accumulation formula, names the exact missing prerequisite instrumentation (a real backlog counter, not yet built), and correctly keeps play separate from novelty/connection per Panksepp's pharmacological-dissociability evidence — verified against the actual (inert, Piaget-scoped) _atick_playing/_play_revisit_known_pairing code at gualaloom_v5_engine.py:11878-11970, which touches no Needs field, exactly as the design states.
mustFix: Rewire curiosity's accumulation to differentiate reading_prediction_ledger.status()['curve'] (accuracy_when_covered rate-of-change over its existing bounded window) and/or knowledge_gap_ledger's real backlog-growth-vs-addressed rate, per the curiosity research's explicit recipe — stop citing Schmidhuber/Oudeyer next to novelty_sig and deep_atlas growth delta, which are verified in code to be raw stimulus-exposure and structure-size metrics respectively, not predictor-quality/error-rate derivatives.

Either drop White/Deci-Ryan/Lintunen from the Learning/Growth drive (the division_pool flux formula is verified to derive 100% from an unrelated embryology fix and 0% from those papers) and rename the drive honestly as growth-pool/neurogenesis pressure, or build an actual competence signal from Lintunen's cited RL formalisms (or from reading_prediction_ledger's accuracy-improvement rate) that the citations would genuinely justify.

Resolve the unaddressed contradiction between the design's 'homeostasis' cross-reference (keep novelty_sig, just unblock it) and its 'curiosity' cross-reference (novelty_sig is the wrong signal, use the ledgers instead) before shipping either recommendation.

For Companionship, either trim the citation list to what the flat scalar accumulate/discharge formula actually embodies (Baumeister & Leary; Gergely & Watson via pair_bond_strength; Tomova) or implement the staged/contingency-timing content (Bowlby/Ainsworth, Trevarthen) that the extra citations describe.

issues.title: division_pool fix reduced to 'verify deployment' misreads the live symptom; the remaining producer of the rail is diet starvation, which the design leaves unfixed
issues.evidence: The design (rootCauseFix 4, drive 3) says the growth law is 'root-cause-repaired' by 82d18ad and 'the remaining action is operational confirmation.' Commit 82d18ad is confirmed on guala-live (git branch --contains). But the stated live symptom is neuron count frozen at 90 with pool 0.00, and embryo.py:196 sets _N_initial = len(OPERATIONS) * seed_size (= 64 for the standard 8x8 seed). 90 > 64 means ~26 real divisions already executed under the NEW law -- i.e. the fix is almost certainly already live and worked for a while. Under the corrected law (embryo.py:721-725), maintenance = 0.02*(90-64) = 0.52 per experience while refill = 0.02*64*sig_res*novelty requires sig_res*novelty > 0.41 to net-positive; a diet dominated by one book repeated 2,347 times drives novelty toward 0 (embryo.py:345-389 self-filling history) and language-only composites drive sig_res to 0.0 (embryo.py:666-671), so the pool drains to 0.00 and freezes -- exactly the observed state. 'Confirm the ECS task runs 82d18ad' will change nothing; the frozen pool is now downstream of SG-1's unfixed book loop plus the language-only diet, neither of which the design touches.

issues.title: rootCauseFix 1 as written ('remove the subtracted constant') converts the connection rail at 0.0 into the opposite rail at ceiling, making gate branch B an always-on ~90s timer
issues.evidence: Verified formula at gualaloom_v5_engine.py:2492-2499: connection_sig = min(0.3, cross_density + pair_boost - 0.3), where cross_density = n_cross/n_atlas*20 is a property of accumulated atlas structure, NOT of current social contact -- it is nonzero with nobody present and is scaled x20. The design claims removing the -0.3 makes 'no recent contact read as neutral (0)'; arithmetically false: min(0.3, cross_density + pair_boost) is >= 0 always and positive whenever any cross-modal bindings exist, giving a permanent contact-independent positive nudge (via regulate at 2373-2378 -> Needs.step 2085-2093) of up to 0.3*0.025 = 0.0075 per 5 ticks = 15x tick_drift's -0.0001/tick. Connection would climb to its saturate() ceiling and stay, valence goes positive, and branch B (connection > 0.70, line 12466) becomes permanently true whenever anyone is present -- autonomous emission then fires at exactly the AUTONOMOUS_THROTTLE_TICKS cadence (27000 ticks ~ 90s, line 1157), which is precisely the disguised-timer signature the whole design exists to avoid. The stability_sig precedent the design cites (2483: (coherence-0.5)*0.2) is a SIGNED recentering, not constant-deletion; the design does not specify the equivalent signed form for connection.

issues.title: Sourcing connection_sig 'directly from pair_bond_strength each regulate() pass' injects a contact-independent constant: the 0.3 cold floor
issues.evidence: Verified at gualaloom_v5_engine.py:2338-2345: pair_bond_strength returns 0.3 for a source with NO interaction log at all, and 0.3 when no interaction occurred in the last 1000 ticks; its formula min(1.0, 0.3 + 0.4*density + 0.3*avg_sal) never goes below 0.3. Wired directly into connection_sig every regulate() pass (rootCauseFix 2, drive-1 integrationPoint 2), a never-contacted source pumps a permanent +0.3-scaled boost -- a constant, not a signal, violating the design's own off-state test ('exactly ZERO on any tick where no real event happened'). The existing recent_connection_boost proxy, whatever its decay flaws, is at least event-gated (only SET inside real read_sentence from a pair-bonded source, line 5136-5137). Any direct sourcing must subtract the 0.3 baseline or gate on a non-empty 1000-tick window; the design specifies neither. Project memory explicitly warns the 0.3 floor is not evidence of contact. Same floor problem applies to integrationPoint 5's 'pair_bond_strength above a floor' presence check: a threshold <= 0.3 is vacuously true for every source including never-contacted ones.

issues.title: Branch C's arousal>0.50 term means the design's 'restores branch reachability' claim is only true in an over-saturated corner, not in the healthy homeostatic state the fixes aim for
issues.evidence: Verified formulas: arousal = min(1, sum|need-0.7|) (2100-2103), valence = mean(need-0.7) (2095-2098), branch C requires arousal>0.50 AND valence>=0 AND stability>=0.7 (12461-12468). issues: CENTRAL DEFECT (RCF-3, hidden cadence — answers scrutiny question 2): the design's load-bearing factual premise is FALSE at the cited line.
